caption: The video captures a translucent amber object with a white ribbed face sitting above footprint-marked sand and moving slowly rightward toward a small yellow object. Near the center-right, the yellow object casts a sharp shadow, while a dark fence shadow crosses the lower left and stays put. As the amber object approaches the yellow object's position, a large soft shadow enters from the right edge. A sudden radial spray of sand erupts around the amber object, opening a dark crater. The amber object is seated inside the crater, and the yellow object is no longer clearly distinguishable. The starburst of airborne sand expands outward from the crater rim. Over the remaining view, the suspended sand gradually thins and settles around the hole. The surrounding footprints, debris flecks, and fence shadow remain essentially unchanged. The camera view stays largely steady, with the visible motion concentrated in the sliding object, the entering shadow, and the spreading sand spray.
relations: As the amber object moves rightward toward the yellow object, the fence shadow and footprints remain static.
When the amber object approaches the yellow object, a large soft shadow enters from the right edge.
As the amber object nears the yellow object, a radial sand spray erupts, opening a dark crater.
The amber object settles inside the crater, and the expanding airborne sand gradually thins and settles.
